description: WO-D3's vault: a real directory of files, enumerated and hashed as a unit, through the real IPC seam into the SDK's ObservationSink. Two ordinary files land as leaves in the scratch witness and re-hash from the bytes on disk. Three refusals — an undeclared MIME, a declared-absent MIME, and a file over the counted ceiling — produce NO leaf and ARE recorded, in a manifest that is itself witnessed.

auditNote:
What each break must do, declared here rather than in the driver, because the answer depends on which assertions THIS scenario makes. The sweep requires each set exactly.

TWO OF THESE ARE INVERSE CONTROLS and they are the interesting ones. `declare-the-undeclared` and `raise-the-ceiling` corrupt nothing: they remove the REASON a file was refused, and the refusal assertions must go red. Measured: with undeclared.png declared, captured goes 2 -> 3 and its bytes land in the witness; with the ceiling raised, oversize.json is read to its full 200000 bytes and captured. A refusal that survived the deletion of its own cause was never caused by what this scenario claims.

`manifest-tamper` edits one refusal in the manifest to `captured` and leaves the JSON valid. What goes red is the DIGEST — which is on a leaf — and the single fact that was edited. That is exactly what witnessing the manifest buys: the record is tamper-EVIDENT, not tamper-proof.

`vault-file-swap` leaves manifest-rehashes GREEN, because the manifest is honestly the digest of what the surface read; only the driver's own pre-swap hash notices the file moved underneath it. Same shape as WO-D2's source-swap finding.

AND THE FINDING FROM THE SWEEP ITSELF: under `fake-bridge` and `no-bridge`, all four `witness-row-absent` assertions stay GREEN. Of course they do — a renderer-side liar produces no leaves at all, so every hash is absent from the witness. That is the honest measure of what a negative assertion is worth ALONE, and it is why each refusal is asserted twice: once as a positive fact in the manifest on disk (which those mutations do redden) and once as an absence in the witness.
